|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Bane''' is a [[skill gem]] that applies a [[debuff]] to enemies in an area, which deals [[Chaos]] [[Damage over Time]]. Linked [[Hex (gem tag)|Hex]] are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each curse applied this way. Bane does not count toward the [[Curse#Curse limit|curse limit]], but the curses it applies do. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Triggering:''' [[Hex]] [[Curse]] skill gems linked with Bane are not directly usable (like other [[trigger]]ing methods). Triggering Bane however will ''not'' trigger any linked curses, since any skill linked with multiple triggers are disabled. Instead the curse skill will trigger alone in sequence as you would expect when linking multiple skills to a single trigger. Bane has no interaction with [[Triggerbots]]. ** Curses applied by Bane are not actually "triggered". Costs of linked curses are ignored; only the cost of the Bane gem itself is used. Support gems supporting only the linked hexes will not apply. * '''Damage bonus:''' The stat {{c|mod|#% more Damage per Curse applied}} is additive per curse linked. For example, a level 20 Bane linked with two curses will deal 84% more Damage. Bane only gains the damage bonus from linked curses. Other sources such as [[curse on hit]], {{il|Blasphemy Support}}, {{il|Vixen's Entrapment}}, and directly casting a curse will not give the damage bonus. Bane will not gain damage if the curse limit is reached (for example attempting to link two curses with a max curse limit of 1). Vixen's Entrapment will not trigger Bane even it is socketed inside the gloves due to lack of gem tag.
